sections.Profile:
The "Sluggin' Champ" pinball machine, manufactured by D. Gottlieb & Co. and released in April 1955, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens. Its baseball theme is enhanced by artwork from Roy Parker. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, four standup targets, and two gobble holes.
